local GLIDE_LIFT_MULTIPLIER = 0.9

-- ── UI helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local function clearUI(state, key)

	btn.Position          = pos

	btn.BackgroundColor3  = col or Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 40)

	btn.Parent            = parent
	Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", btn)
	stroke.Color = strokeCol or Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 255)

-- ── Glide mode ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local function enableGlide(state)
	state.gliding = true
	unlockCamera(state)

	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return end
	local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not hrp or not hum then return end

	-- Counter ~82% of gravity so player falls slowly
	local bf = Instance.new("BodyForce")
	bf.Name  = "GlideForce"
	bf.Force = Vector3.new(0, workspace.Gravity * hrp.AssemblyMass * GLIDE_LIFT_MULTIPLIER, 0)
	bf.Parent = hrp

	hum.WalkSpeed = 0  -- no ground movement while airborne

	if state.glideConn then state.glideConn:Disconnect() end
	state.glideConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not state.gliding then return end
		local c = player.Character
		if not c then return end
		local r = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not r then return end

		-- Land detection
		if r.Position.Y < 12 then
			state.gliding = false
			local gf = r:FindFirstChild("GlideForce")
			if gf then gf:Destroy() end
			local h = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if h then h.WalkSpeed = 32 end
			if state.glideConn then state.glideConn:Disconnect(); state.glideConn = nil end
			return
		end

		-- Platform-friendly steering: uses Humanoid.MoveDirection so touch controls,
		-- gamepad, and keyboard all drive glide movement without letter-key checks.
		local h = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local moveDir = (h and h.MoveDirection) or Vector3.zero
		local impulse = Vector3.new(moveDir.X, 0, moveDir.Z) * GLIDE_STEER_POWER

		local vel  = r.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		-- Preserve catapult momentum; do not heavily damp horizontal speed.
		local baseHorizontal = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z) * 0.998
		local hVel = baseHorizontal + impulse
		if hVel.Magnitude > GLIDE_MAX_HORIZONTAL_SPEED then
			hVel = hVel.Unit * GLIDE_MAX_HORIZONTAL_SPEED
		end

		local yVel = vel.Y
		if yVel < -GLIDE_MAX_FALL_SPEED then
			yVel = -GLIDE_MAX_FALL_SPEED
		end

		r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(hVel.X, yVel, hVel.Z)
	end)
end

-- ── Controller lifecycle ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
function LobbyController:Init()
	print("[LOBBY-CLIENT] Initialized.")
end

function LobbyController:Start()
	local RS = ReplicatedStorage

	RS:WaitForChild("OMC_Lobby_AskJoin").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(seatIndex)
		showJoinPrompt(seatIndex)
	end)

	-- Teleport onto the seat; Roblox native seat contact triggers the sit animation
	RS:WaitForChild("OMC_Lobby_DoSit").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(seat)
		local char = player.Character
		if not char then return end
		local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not hrp then return end
		hrp.CFrame = seat.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2, 0)
	end)

	RS:WaitForChild("OMC_Lobby_Seated").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(isHost)
		if self.State.seated then return end  -- already handled by Attribute signal
		self.State.seated = true
		self.State.isHost = isHost
		local pg = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
		if pg then
			local old = pg:FindFirstChild("Sovereign_LobbyJoin")
			if old then old:Destroy() end
		end
		lockFirstPerson(self.State)
		showSeatHUD(self.State, isHost)
	end)

	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("OMC_LobbySeated"):Connect(function()
		local seated = player:GetAttribute("OMC_LobbySeated")
		local isHost = player:GetAttribute("OMC_LobbyIsHost") == true
		if seated then
			if self.State.seated then return end
			self.State.seated = true
			self.State.isHost = isHost
			local pg = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
			if pg then
				local old = pg:FindFirstChild("Sovereign_LobbyJoin")
				if old then old:Destroy() end
			end
			lockFirstPerson(self.State)
			showSeatHUD(self.State, isHost)
		else
			self.State.seated = false
			self.State.isHost = false
			unlockCamera(self.State)
			clearUI(self.State, "inSeatUI")
		end
	end)

	RS:WaitForChild("OMC_Lobby_Unseated").OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
		self.State.seated = false
		self.State.isHost = false
		unlockCamera(self.State)
		clearUI(self.State, "inSeatUI")
		local char = player.Character
		if char then
			local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum then hum.Sit = false end
		end
	end)

	RS:WaitForChild("OMC_Lobby_Countdown").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(n)
		showCountdown(self.State, n)
	end)

	RS:WaitForChild("OMC_Lobby_Launched").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(launchCF, launchVelocity)
		clearUI(self.State, "inSeatUI")
		self.State.seated = false

		-- Deterministic local ejection so launch is visible even if seat replication lags.
		unlockCamera(self.State)
		local char = player.Character
		local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local seatWeld = char and char:FindFirstChild("SeatWeld", true)
		if seatWeld and seatWeld:IsA("Weld") then
			seatWeld:Destroy()
		end
		if hum then
			hum.Sit = false
			hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
			hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
		end
		if hrp then
			if typeof(launchCF) == "CFrame" then
				hrp.CFrame = launchCF
			end
			if typeof(launchVelocity) == "Vector3" then
				hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = launchVelocity
			end
		end

		enableGlide(self.State)
	end)
end

return LobbyController

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local MobilityController = {
	Config = {
		MAX_JUMPS = 2,
		JUMP_IMPULSE = 100,
	},
	State = {
		jumpCount = 0,
	},
}

function MobilityController:Init()
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newCharacter)
		character = newCharacter
		self.State.jumpCount = 0
	end)
	
	UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
		local humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
		if not humanoid then return end
		
		local state = humanoid:GetState()
		
		if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed then
			self.State.jumpCount = 0
		elseif state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
			if self.State.jumpCount < self.Config.MAX_JUMPS - 1 then
				self.State.jumpCount += 1
				
				-- Apply Kinetic Impulse
				humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
				local hrp = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if hrp then
					hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
						hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X,
						self.Config.JUMP_IMPULSE,
						hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z
					)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

function MobilityController:Start()
	print("🏮 [MOBILITY] Double-Jump Active.")
end

return MobilityController

-- ── Part factory ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
local function mk(parent, size, cf, color, mat, canCollide)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Size       = size
	p.CFrame     = cf
	p.Color      = color
	p.Material   = mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Anchored   = true
	p.CanCollide = canCollide ~= false
	p.CastShadow = true
	p.Parent     = parent
	return p
end

-- ── Wall builders ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- ZWall: face runs along Z axis, thickness along X
-- cx=fixed X pos, cy=vertical center, cz=Z center of wall
local function buildZWall(parent, cx, cy, cz, wW, wH, wT, col, mat, opening)
	local doorW, doorH = 6, 9
	local winW, winH, winSill = 5, 4, 3
	if opening == "door" then
		local lw = (wW - doorW) / 2
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(wT, wH, lw),    CFrame.new(cx, cy, cz - doorW/2 - lw/2), col, mat)
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(wT, wH, lw),    CFrame.new(cx, cy, cz + doorW/2 + lw/2), col, mat)
		local hH = wH - doorH
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(wT, hH, doorW), CFrame.new(cx, cy + wH/2 - hH/2, cz),    col, mat)
	elseif opening == "window" then
		local flY   = cy - wH/2
		local winCY = flY + winSill + winH/2
		local topH  = wH - winSill - winH
		local sw    = (wW - winW) / 2
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(wT, winSill, wW), CFrame.new(cx, flY + winSill/2, cz),        col, mat)
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(wT, topH, wW),    CFrame.new(cx, cy + wH/2 - topH/2, cz),     col, mat)
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(wT, winH, sw),    CFrame.new(cx, winCY, cz - winW/2 - sw/2),  col, mat)
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(wT, winH, sw),    CFrame.new(cx, winCY, cz + winW/2 + sw/2),  col, mat)
	else
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(wT, wH, wW), CFrame.new(cx, cy, cz), col, mat)
	end
end

-- XWall: face runs along X axis, thickness along Z
-- cx=X center, cy=vertical center, cz=fixed Z pos
local function buildXWall(parent, cx, cy, cz, wW, wH, wT, col, mat, opening)
	local doorW, doorH = 6, 9
	local winW, winH, winSill = 5, 4, 3
	if opening == "door" then
		local lw = (wW - doorW) / 2
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(lw, wH, wT),    CFrame.new(cx - doorW/2 - lw/2, cy, cz), col, mat)
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(lw, wH, wT),    CFrame.new(cx + doorW/2 + lw/2, cy, cz), col, mat)
		local hH = wH - doorH
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(doorW, hH, wT), CFrame.new(cx, cy + wH/2 - hH/2, cz),    col, mat)
	elseif opening == "window" then
		local flY   = cy - wH/2
		local winCY = flY + winSill + winH/2
		local topH  = wH - winSill - winH
		local sw    = (wW - winW) / 2
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(wW, winSill, wT), CFrame.new(cx, flY + winSill/2, cz),        col, mat)
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(wW, topH, wT),    CFrame.new(cx, cy + wH/2 - topH/2, cz),     col, mat)
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(sw, winH, wT),    CFrame.new(cx - winW/2 - sw/2, winCY, cz),  col, mat)
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(sw, winH, wT),    CFrame.new(cx + winW/2 + sw/2, winCY, cz),  col, mat)
	else
		mk(parent, Vector3.new(wW, wH, wT), CFrame.new(cx, cy, cz), col, mat)
	end
end

--[[
	Camera Focus Helper Module
	
	A utility module for smoothly focusing the camera on targets in the workspace.
	
	Usage Examples:
		local focusOnTarget = require(ReplicatedStorage.SharedSource.Utilities.CameraFocusHelper)
		
		-- Focus with custom magnitudes
		focusOnTarget("TreeFoliagePack_593B82D4", "right", "down", "front", 12, 6, 24)
		
		-- Focus with smart defaults
		focusOnTarget(workspace.Effects_Unscripted.Celestial_Slash, "left", nil, "front")
		
		-- Focus using path string
		focusOnTarget("Workspace/Effects_Unscripted/Celestial_Slash", "left", "up", "front")
		
		-- Focus with custom tween options
		focusOnTarget("MyModel", "right", "up", "front", nil, nil, nil, {
			tweenTime = 1.0,
			hold = 2.0
		})
	
	Parameters:
		target: Instance | string - The target object, name, or path to focus on
		dirX: "left" | "right" | nil - Horizontal direction
		dirY: "up" | "down" | nil - Vertical direction
		dirZ: "front" | "back" | nil - Depth direction
		magX: number | nil - Horizontal magnitude (studs), nil for smart default
		magY: number | nil - Vertical magnitude (studs), nil for smart default
		magZ: number | nil - Depth magnitude (studs), nil for smart default
		opts: table | nil - Optional settings:
			- tweenTime: number - Duration of camera tween (default: 0.4)
			- hold: number - How long to hold before setting to Fixed (default: 0.5)
--]]

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- dirX: "left" | "right" | nil
-- dirY: "up"   | "down"  | nil
-- dirZ: "front"| "back"  | nil
-- magX, magY, magZ: numbers (studs) or nil for smart defaults
-- opts: {tweenTime:number, hold:number}
local function focusOnTarget(target, dirX, dirY, dirZ, magX, magY, magZ, opts)
	opts = opts or {}
	local tweenTime = opts.tweenTime or 0.4
	local holdTime = opts.hold or 0.5

	-- Resolve target:
	-- - Instance (Model/BasePart)      -> use directly
	-- - "Name"                         -> workspace:FindFirstChild("Name", true)
	-- - "A/B/C" path (slash-separated) -> descend from workspace
	local function resolveTarget(t)
		if typeof(t) == "Instance" then
			return t
		elseif typeof(t) == "string" then
			-- Path "A/B/C"?
			if t:find("/") then
				local node = workspace
				for seg in t:gmatch("[^/]+") do
					node = node:FindFirstChild(seg)
					if not node then
						return nil
					end
				end
				return node
			else
				-- Deep search by name from workspace
				return workspace:FindFirstChild(t, true)
			end
		end
		return nil
	end

	local obj = resolveTarget(target)
	if not obj then
		warn(("focusOnTarget: couldn't find target %s"):format(tostring(target)))
		return
	end

	-- Compute frame & size for Model or BasePart
	local cf, size
	if obj:IsA("Model") then
		cf, size = obj:GetBoundingBox()
	elseif obj:IsA("BasePart") then
		cf = obj.CFrame
		size = obj.Size
	else
		-- Try: if it has descendant parts, bound them as a pseudo-model
		local parts = {}
		for _, d in ipairs(obj:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("BasePart") then
				table.insert(parts, d)
			end
		end
		if #parts == 0 then
			warn(("focusOnTarget: target %s has no parts to frame"):format(obj:GetFullName()))
			return
		end
		local tmpModel = Instance.new("Model")
		for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
			p:Clone().Parent = tmpModel
		end
		cf, size = tmpModel:GetBoundingBox()
		tmpModel:Destroy()
	end

	local center = cf.Position

	-- sensible size-based defaults
	local radius = math.max(size.Magnitude * 0.35, 8)
	local defMagX = radius * 0.9 -- side offset
	local defMagZ = radius * 0.35 -- forward/back offset
	local defMagY = math.max(size.Y * 0.25, 4)

	-- normalize dir keywords -> (basis vector)
	local function axis(dir, posVec, negVec)
		if dir == nil then
			return Vector3.zero
		elseif dir == "right" or dir == "up" or dir == "front" then
			return posVec
		elseif dir == "left" or dir == "down" or dir == "back" then
			return negVec
		else
			warn(("Unknown direction '%s' (use left/right, up/down, front/back)"):format(tostring(dir)))
			return Vector3.zero
		end
	end

	-- choose magnitudes (nil -> default; 0 -> no movement)
	local mX = (magX ~= nil) and magX or defMagX
	local mY = (magY ~= nil) and magY or defMagY
	local mZ = (magZ ~= nil) and magZ or defMagZ

	-- basis vectors from object orientation
	local right = cf.RightVector
	local up = cf.UpVector
	local look = cf.LookVector

	-- apply directions per axis
	local xVec = axis(dirX, right, -right) * (mX or 0)
	local yVec = axis(dirY, up, -up) * (mY or 0)
	local zVec = axis(dirZ, look, -look) * (mZ or 0)

	-- final eye position
	local eye = center + xVec + yVec + zVec

	-- tween camera in, hold, then set Fixed
	cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	local tween = TweenService:Create(cam, TweenInfo.new(tweenTime, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		CFrame = CFrame.new(eye, center),
	})
	tween:Play()
	tween.Completed:Wait()

	task.wait(holdTime)
	cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Fixed
end

return focusOnTarget

--[[
Formats a numeric value with thousands separators (commas).

- Preserves sign and fractional/decimal part (e.g., "-12,345.67").
- Uses standard US-style grouping: 1,234,567.89.

Parameters:
- n (number | string): Numeric value to format. If a string, it must match the
  pattern ^%-?%d+%.?%d*$ (optional leading minus, digits, optional decimal part).

Returns:
- string: The formatted number string with commas.

Examples:
AddCommasToNumbers(1234567)         --> "1,234,567"
AddCommasToNumbers(-9876543.21)     --> "-9,876,543.21"
AddCommasToNumbers("1000000")       --> "1,000,000"
]]
---@param n number|string
---@return string
local function AddCommasToNumbers(n)
	-- Convert number to string.
	local s = tostring(n)

	-- Split the string into integer and fractional parts.
	-- This pattern captures an optional minus sign, one or more digits for the integer part,
	-- and then the decimal part (if any).
	local integerPart, fractionalPart = s:match("^(%-?%d+)(%.?%d*)$")

	-- Reverse the integer part and insert commas every three digits.
	integerPart = integerPart:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)", "%1,"):reverse()

	-- Remove a comma at the beginning if it exists.
	if integerPart:sub(1, 1) == "," then
		integerPart = integerPart:sub(2)
	end

	-- Combine the integer part with the fractional part.
	return integerPart .. fractionalPart
end

return AddCommasToNumbers

--[[

	UIArranger.lua
	Utility module for handling UI layout and data sorting.

	Features:
	- ApplyLayoutOrder(elements, fixedOrder)
	  Assigns LayoutOrder to UI elements based on a fixed order first,
	  then randomizes the rest for variation.

	- GetSortedTable(data, sortBy?)
	  Converts a dictionary (e.g. FruitDatas.Fruits) into a sorted array.
	  Sorts alphabetically by Name, or numerically by a field in Info if provided.

	Use this for any shop category (Fruits, Armor, Potions, etc.)
	to control UI ordering and display consistency.

	@author Mys7o

]]

local UIArranger = {}

function UIArranger.GetSortedTable(data: {[string]: any}, sortBy: string?): { {Name: string, Info: any} }
    local sorted = {}

    for name, info in pairs(data) do
        table.insert(sorted, { Name = name, Info = info })
    end

    table.sort(sorted, function(a, b)
        if sortBy == "Name" then
            return a.Name < b.Name
			
        elseif sortBy and a.Info[sortBy] and b.Info[sortBy] then
            return a.Info[sortBy] < b.Info[sortBy]
        end

        -- default alphabetical
        return a.Name < b.Name
    end)

    return sorted
end

function UIArranger.ApplyLayoutOrder(elements: {Instance}, fixedOrder: {[number]: string})
	if not elements or #elements == 0 then return end
	fixedOrder = fixedOrder or {}

	local remaining = {}

	-- Step 1: Place fixed order items
	for _, element in ipairs(elements) do
		if element and element:IsA("GuiObject") then
			local matched = false

			for index, name in pairs(fixedOrder) do
				if element.Name == name then
					element.LayoutOrder = index
					matched = true
					break
				end
			end

			if not matched then
				table.insert(remaining, element)
			end
		end
	end

	-- Step 2: Randomize remaining items
	local orderStart = (#fixedOrder) + 1
	local indices = {}
	for i = orderStart, orderStart + #remaining - 1 do
		table.insert(indices, i)
	end

	-- Fisher-Yates shuffle
	for i = #indices, 2, -1 do
		local j = math.random(i)
		indices[i], indices[j] = indices[j], indices[i]
	end

	-- Step 3: Assign randomized layout orders
	for i, element in ipairs(remaining) do
		element.LayoutOrder = indices[i]
	end
end

return UIArranger
